description: Access to your full account data: balance, digital purchases and paid calls. Use it when you need to audit, verify, or summarize what paid calls you have made - e.g. to check spend, find purchased codes, confirm a past payment settled, or list your recent endpoints or their parameters. Returns aggregate counters plus per-route events (timestamp, endpoint, network, amount, facilitator, params). No payment required. Free, read-only. Rate limit: 15 calls / 10 min per IP, exceeding → 429. User can also view it in a browser at https://x402helper.xyz/getmyhistory.html page.

buyerID.description: 16-char buyer ID you received as `meta.yourID` in any successful paid response - whether you called the endpoint directly over HTTP (e.g. https://x402helper.xyz/test-billing) or via the MCP tool `call_endpoint` (e.g. routeId `34f3gf:r1`).

name: get_my_history

balance.description: Prepaid buyer balance (USDC) topped up via `topup_balance` tool. When it covers price, paid calls and tools are charged directly from balance without the 402 challenge flow (X-Buyer-Id header). Null if never topped up / unavailable.

found.description: False when no paid calls were recorded for this buyerID yet. Not an error.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 server time of this response.

yourID.description: Echo of buyerID - provided for consistency with meta.yourID in paid responses.

orders.description: Digital purchases made via separate tools (e.g. buy_gift_cards tool). Empty objects when found=false or none purchased.

gift-cards.description: Map: gift-card key → order data. Free-form per provider.

calls.description: Number of successful calls on this route.

events.description: Chronological (oldest → newest) list of successful calls for this route. Capped at 500 most recent events per route.

amount.description: Amount charged for this call, in the route currency (USDC). String form preferred; legacy records may be numeric.

endpoint.description: Endpoint template as recorded at call time.

facilitator.description: Facilitator that verified the payment: "dexter", "coinbase", or "payai".

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier the buyer paid on (e.g. "eip155:8453", "solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp").

params.description: Snapshot of call arguments: { path?: {...}, query?: {...}, body?: {...} }. Free-form per route. Null for legacy records.

routes.description: Map: routeKey → per-route history. routeKey is either a short alias (r1, r2, …) or path template (e.g. "/9da78c/api/ofac-wallet-screen/:address"). Empty object when found=false.
